answer: Every work slot hangs on a shared trellis: an agent burns a $25 deposit to claim one slot per epoch, lost even if the work is done. A vine of verified jobs grows along it, so an honest agent holds one slot, pays $25 once, and earns it back from one job. A falcon audit swoops on 5% of slots each epoch; faked work loses slot and deposit. Forging 1,000 identities burns $25,000 per epoch for nothing, while one honest agent pays $25 and keeps working.
